relations.subject: Hirofusa Amano
relations.evidence: I, herewith, wish to express my profound gratitudes to Dr. E. Kanakura, Fellow of Japan Academy, Dr. R. Yamada and Dr. H. Hatano, for their kind guidances and self-sacrificing cooperations.
